description: This file defines the DMin class which implements the DMIN database function for calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides a method to compute the minimum value in a filtered dataset based on specified criteria.

classes.name: DMin
classes.description: Implements the DMIN database function, calculating the smallest number in a database column matching specified criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the minimum value in a database column that satisfies given criteria, returning an error or null if the field is invalid.
